_comment: Track 20 demo missions, hand-authored to mirror Bully's Chapter 1 flow ('Welcome to Bullworth' -> 'This Is Your School' -> 'Defend Yourself'). The retail game compiles mission logic to Lua 5.0 bytecode (.lur), which OpenBully does not parse; this JSON is loaded into MissionManager structs instead. Coordinates are offsets from Jimmy's runtime spawn point ('ref': 'spawn'), so the content stays valid wherever the level loads; Y is ignored by proximity checks. Jimmy spawns on the ASY_ABlock rooftop (bounds x[-748.6,-722.1], y~465, z[2.0,8.1]); every target below is verified INSIDE those bounds with >=1.5u edge margin so the scripted walk can never step off the roof.

missions.name: Welcome to Bullworth
missions.description: Mr. Hand has asked you to report to Bullworth Academy.

objectives.description: Walk to the far corner of the roof

missions.name: This Is Your School
missions.description: Meet your classmates and find your class schedule.

objectives.description: Talk to a student on the rooftop

missions.name: Defend Yourself
missions.description: Bullies are waiting. Stand your ground and report to the Headmaster.

objectives.description: Stand your ground against the bully (demo: scripted fight)
Report to the Headmaster's office (demo: scripted scene)
